import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def fetch_arxiv_page(start=0):
    # Using %20 for spaces to avoid control-character errors in URL
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start}&max_results=25&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    return web_fetch(url=url)

# XML namespaces used by arXiv
NS = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

def is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
    """Checks if the paper is relevant to multimodal RAG."""
    text = f"{title} {summary}".lower()
    # Keywords related to Multimodality
    multimodal_keywords = [
        'ultimodal', 'vision', 'visual', 'image', 'video', 'audio', 
        'peech', 'cross-modal', 'crossmodal', 'vlm', 'vision-language',
        'vision language', 'graph', 'document', 'table', 'chart'
    ]
    # Keywords related to RAG
    rag_keywords = ['rag', 'etrieval-augmented', 'etrieval augmented']
    
    has_multimodal = any(kw in text for kw in multimodal_keywords)
    has_rag = any(kw in text for kw in rag_keywords)
    
    # If it's specifically RAG and has some multimodal connotation, it's a match
    return has_multimodal and has_rag

papers_collected = []
start_index = 0
max_results_to_find = 5

while len(papers_collected) < max_results_to_find and start_index < 200:
    resp = fetch_arxiv_page(start_index)
    if resp.get('status')!= 200:
        print(f"Error fetching: {resp}")
        break
    
    root = ET.fromstring(resp['content'])
    entries = root.findall('atom:entry', NS)
    
    if not entries:
        break
        
    for entry in entries:
        title_elem = entry.find('atom:title', NS)
        summary_elem = entry.find('atom:summary', NS)
        updated_elem = entry.find('atom:updated', NS)
        id_elem = entry.find('atom:id', NS)
        
        if None in (title_elem, summary_elem, updated_elem, id_elem):
            continue
            
        title = title_elem.text.strip()
        summary = summary_elem.text.strip()
        updated = updated_elem.text.strip()[:10] # YYYY-MM-DD
        arxiv_id = id_elem.text.strip()
        
        # Get the HTML link
        link = ""
        for link_el in entry.findall('atom:link', NS):
            if link_el.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link_el.get('type') == 'text/html':
                link = link_el.get('href')
                break
        
        if is_multimodal_rag_paper(title, summary):
            papers_collected.append({
                'title': title,
                'date': updated,
                'ummary': summary,
                'link': link
            })
            if len(papers_collected) >= max_results_to_find:
                break
                
    start_index += 25

# Create the comparison table
def generate_markdown(papers):
    md = "| Rank | Title | Date | Key Findings / Summary |\n"
    md += "| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n"
    for i, p in enumerate(papers, 1):
        # Clean summary for table: remove newlines, truncate, escape pipes
        clean_sum = '.join(p['summary'].split())
        clean_sum = clean_sum[:150].replace('|', '\\|') + "..." if len(clean_sum) > 150 else clean_sum
        md += f"| {i} | {p['title'].replace('|', '\\|')} | {p['date']} | {clean_sum} |\n"
    return md

markdown_content = generate_markdown(papers_collected)

with open('papers.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(markdown_content)

print(f"Successfully wrote {len(papers_collected)} papers to papers.md")
finish(summary="Found 5 recent multimodal RAG papers from arXiv and wrote a comparison table to papers.md")
